mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 62 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School. We have a waxing crescent moon, and the ISS will be visible for four minutes starting at 4:47 AM, moving from the south near Belleville toward the east near Fitchburg.

The City of Verona has announced that road construction along Highway M is set to begin on August 18, which will include traffic shifts and temporary closures for utility work. Additionally, the Senior Center is looking for volunteers to assist with their services; please check the city website if you would like to help.

Today, Epic Systems is holding its annual User Group Meeting. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and later in the week, check out the Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday or Concerts in the Park on Thursday.
On Wednesday, August 5, officers responded to a call on Whalen Road to locate a man with a probation warrant, who was eventually taken into custody after a brief attempt to flee.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM.
